Purple Dragon PowerTools

A Windows system utility and AI command center with clear status, quick navigation, and workspace memory.

Available · v2.5.2
Get the softwareRepositoryGet help

What it does

  • System and network utilities
  • Local or configured cloud-model workflows
  • Notification history, Quiet Mode, and verified release updates

Requirements

Windows x64. Provider features may require separately installed software.

Getting started

Choose the installer or portable package from the stable release. Follow the release’s checksum and signed-manifest instructions.

v2.5.2 release update

The published v2.5.2 packages include the status-refresh hotfix and open this website after a successful interactive Setup uninstall. Silent removals and upgrades do not open it. Portable has no uninstaller. Windows executable signing and native browser-launch acceptance remain pending. The repository README still describes v2.5.0; the linked release notes record the newer published packages.

Release notes, integrity & license

Read the current project documentation before installing. Where a release supplies checksums or signed manifests, use the instructions for that exact package. Check the repository’s license and third-party notices before reusing code or assets.

Project information reviewed November 12, 2026. For new versions, follow the repository’s release notes.
